content:
maria (infra): FYI starting an AZ13 bring-up validation. hitting a 'handshake' failure between provisioner and edge loadbalancer.
oliver (network): seen the alert. BGP session flapping on az13-edge-rt-1. 10:48 UTC.
maria (infra): digging in — provisioning logs show repeated 502s from edge-proxy during k8s node join. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T10:47:02Z] PROVISIONER: attach network interface -> ERROR code=E_NET_HANDSHAKE timeout
[2026-03-18T10:47:06Z] EDGE-PROXY: upstream health check failed -> 502
```
raj (eng-infra): @maria can you paste the cloud quota check? last time AZ12 failed due to GPU quota mismatch.
maria (infra): ran quota check. GPU quota shows 0/120 reserved available but allocation request failing with validation error:
```
api: request allocation -> status=400 message="gpu:flavor-nv48 not available in az13"
```
samir (capacity): that's weird — we've reserved capacity for az13 in the contract. Let me re-check the region mapping table.
bootstrap-bot: [10:51 UTC] provisioner-event: attempt=3 instance=az13-nodepool-2 state=attach-nic -> FAILED
oliver (network): found misconfig: edge-rt-1 ACL referencing old v4 prefix (10.5.0.0/16) instead of new 10.9.0.0/16 used by AZ13. BGP learned routes intermittently drop when neighbor filters applied.
maria (infra): AH — that explains handshake. Provisioner tries new IP range, LB healthcheck mismatch leads to 502. How did ACL get set to old prefix?
raj (eng-infra): config drift during terraform apply. I pushed a provider bump yesterday that didn't include az13 varset.
sophie (oncall): current impact: node joins failing; canaries = 0/3. Not yet customer-facing but blocks finishing bootstrap.
samir (capacity): temporary mitigation: can we point az13 nodepool to fallback subnet in az11 for initial bootstrap? costs might spike but will let joins complete.
maria (infra): yes we can. plan: (1) patch edge ACL to include 10.9.0.0/16 (2) enable fallback subnet for nodepool (3) re-run provisioner. timeline ~20-30m if no surprises.
oliver (network): ACL quick patch ready. applying change in 2m. will monitor BGP sessions.
bootstrap-bot: [10:58 UTC] network-change: ACL updated for edge-rt-1 add 10.9.0.0/16 by oliver
oliver (network): BGP sessions stable now, no more flap events. edge healthchecks returning 200/healthy.
maria (infra): re-triggering provisioner for nodepool-2.
bootstrap-bot: [11:03 UTC] provisioner-event: attempt=4 instance=az13-nodepool-2 state=attach-nic -> OK
raj (eng-infra): nice. follow-up: we should add a terraform test to assert ACL prefix var sync across regions to avoid drift.
samir (capacity): cost note: using az11 fallback will spin up on different racks with higher preemption risk; recommend we only use fallback for bootstrap window (<=1h). also update committed capacity ledger.
sophie (oncall): handoff checklist: 1) confirm all nodes Ready, 2) run kube conformance smoke, 3) remove fallback route, 4) record incident in runbook.
maria (infra): status: nodes Ready = 8/8, canaries 3/3 passed initial probes. running conformance smoke now.
raj (eng-infra): created PR to add terraform test and a small validation script: `scripts/validate-region-acl.sh` that cross-checks varsets -> provider state.
maria (infra): conformance smoke OK. proceeding to remove fallback subnet routing in 5m and keep close watch.
bootstrap-bot: [11:12 UTC] provisioner-event: nodepool-2 complete. metrics: join-latency median=32s.
sophie (oncall): logging action items in the runbook: - known issue: terraform var drift can leave ACLs out-of-sync causing BGP flaps - mitigation: fallback subnet + ACL patch - postmortem owner: raj
samir (capacity): I'll reconcile committed vs actual capacity numbers and flag any billing delta. estimate delta < 4% for the bootstrap window.
maria (infra): final handoff note: AZ13 brought up successfully after network ACL fix. update runbook section "az13 edge handshake" with commands used and replay steps. tagging @raj for terraform follow-up and @samir for capacity reconciliation. closing thread.
oliver (network): adding the ACL diff to infra-notes with the exact change snippet.
raj (eng-infra): will own postmortem + PR. thanks everyone for quick triage. :thumbsup:
